description: This is a white, three-dimensional model of a lamp holder. The base of the holder is designed with five curved, petal-like arms that extend outwards and upwards, forming a visually appealing structure. At the center of the base, a support rises vertically, leading to a cylindrical top piece. This top piece appears to be a socket or a decorative element for a lampshade. The entire object is rendered in a clean, minimalist style against a plain gray background. The design is delicate and artistic, suggesting it could be part of a decorative lighting fixture.
